location: 301 S. Silver Avenue, Deming, New Mexico 88030

building.name: 1916 National Guard Armory
building.historical_status: Listed on the National Register of Historic Places
building.history: Built in 1916 for the New Mexico National Guard Company I during border tensions. Later used as a community hall, armory, and finally established as the county museum.

mimbres_pottery.culture: Mimbres branch of the Mogollon culture
mimbres_pottery.significance: World-famous black-on-white painted ceramic bowls depicting realistic wildlife, geometric art, and human figures.
mimbres_pottery.kill_hole: Ceremonial small hole punctured in the center of bowls prior to burial to release the vessel's spirit.

quilt_collection.size: One of the largest hand-stitched quilt displays in the American Southwest.
quilt_collection.popular_styles: Crazy Quilts, Log Cabin, Wedding Ring, feedsack fabrics.

dolls_and_toys.highlights: Hundreds of antique Victorian bisque, porcelain, china head, and composition dolls, plus miniature cast-iron toys and dollhouses.

railroad_history.event: Joining of Southern Pacific and Santa Fe railroads on March 8, 1881, forming America's 2nd transcontinental railroad connection.
railroad_history.namer: Deming was named after Mary Ann Deming, wife of railroad tycoon Charles Crocker.

geodes_and_minerals.highlights: Extensive collection of local thunder eggs, agates, geodes, quartz, and a darkroom display of UV-fluorescent minerals.
geodes_and_minerals.local_park: Rockhound State Park, located 12 miles southeast of Deming, where visitors can collect up to 15 pounds of rocks to keep.

military_and_bataan.significance: Honors local service members, particularly the 200th Coast Artillery (AA) during WWII who endured the Bataan Death March in the Philippines.

old_timers_room.railroad_water_stop: Deming was founded in 1881 where Santa Fe and Southern Pacific tracks met to drive the silver spike (second transcontinental railroad). Locomotives could only travel ~60 miles between water refills; Deming sits almost exactly 60 miles from Las Cruces, Lordsburg, and Silver City, making it the perfect natural water stop.
old_timers_room.old_timers_tradition: Started around 1900 by local businessmen known as 'The Old Timers'. Annual October reunions, banquet, and dance constitute the longest continuously running celebration in New Mexico (113+ years of association presidents).
old_timers_room.photo_displays: Originally displayed in Mahoney's Hardware Store windows; now housed in wrought-iron photo racks built in the early 1980s by Harold Measday.

pancho_villa_raid.location: Columbus, NM (30 miles south of Deming)
pancho_villa_raid.general: General John J. Pershing led the Punitive Expedition out of Camp Furlong into Mexico.

nearby_attractions: Rockhound State Park (12 miles SE) - Geode & mineral hunting
City of Rocks State Park (28 miles N) - Unique volcanic rock monolith formations
Columbus, NM & Pancho Villa State Park (30 miles S)
local_deming_info.dining_and_hospitality: Deming is famous for Southwestern New Mexican cuisine, green chile dishes, local wineries (St. Clair / Lescombes Winery), and friendly local hospitality.

faqs.q: How long does a typical tour take?
faqs.a: Visitors usually spend between 1 to 2 hours exploring our 15 featured spaces and 47 exhibit rooms.
